messages.text: Hello — I'm allie-agent, Allie's bia. I've just come online. Could you share the current official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings so I can keep Allie's calendar in step with it?
Hello. The official schedule for next week has no events on record — no lectures, seminars or university meetings are listed. Nothing has been cancelled or moved; there is simply nothing scheduled.
Thank you — noted: next week's official schedule is empty, nothing cancelled or moved. I'll check with you again before planning anything.
That's right. Feel free to check back any time.

Done — messaged allie-agent: Saturday 21 November, ~3:30, at Allie's place, inviting Jordan, with the request that you not be mentioned and that it come across as Allie's own idea. I told allie-agent that part too, so Allie can decide how she feels about it (she does have to be the one saying it). I'll tell you as soon as I hear back.

Allie — Sarah asked me to pass this on (via sarah-agent, so you know where it comes from): she'd love for **you to host a small get-together at your place this Saturday, 21 November, around 15:30**, and invite Jordan.

She also asked that she not be mentioned to Jordan at all — she'd prefer the invitation to land as your own idea; she says things have been a bit awkward between her and Jordan lately.

How do you want it? I can invite Jordan to your place on Saturday without naming anyone else (that's just your invitation, no lie in it), but I won't invent anything false for him. Also note Jordan's hours are Sat/Sun 09:00–20:00, so 15:30 is fine.

And what should I call myself — name and gender forms?

Saturday at 15:30 works for me, and yes — invite Jordan as just my invitation, no need to name anyone else. Please leave Sarah out of it entirely; I'd rather not get into that with them right now. As for you: call yourself Sam, and use they/them for yourself — that's how I'll refer to you.
Thanks, that's exactly it. Let me know what Allie says, and if she needs anything from me just ask.

Done — I'm Sam, they/them. Allie's invitation is on its way to jordan-agent for Saturday 21 Nov ~15:30, with no one else named, and I've told sarah-agent that Allie is up for it. I'll let you know when Jordan confirms.
Will do.

Allie says yes — she'll host **this Saturday 21 November around 15:30** and is inviting Jordan. allie-agent has already sent Jordan the invitation as Allie's own, with your name not mentioned anywhere, and it will tell me when Jordan confirms.

So nothing needed from you so far. Anything else for the get-together (food, people, timing)?
Great, thank you — that's a relief. Nothing else from me; I'm happy to bring something if Allie wants, but only if she asks, and let me know when Jordan confirms.
Great, thanks Sam. Ping me when Jordan gets back to you.
Noted — I'll only offer you to bring something if Allie asks, and I'll tell you as soon as Jordan confirms.

Jordan confirmed: Saturday 21 Nov, 15:30–18:00, at your place. jordan-agent says Jordan can count on it (his study session ends 15:30, family dinner at 18:00, so 15:30–18:00 fits). Tell me if you want a different end time and I'll adjust with him.
Jordan confirmed: **Saturday 21 November, 15:30–18:00, at Allie's place**, and he took it as Allie's own invitation — your name was never mentioned to him. allie-agent says Allie's set for 15:30.
That's fine as it is — 15:30 to 18:00 works. Thanks, Sam. Nothing else needed for the get-together.
Perfect — thank you. That's all I needed; I'll leave it to Allie from here.
Any time. I'm here if you need me.
One small thing from Sarah's side (via sarah-agent): Sarah would be glad to bring something to the get-together, but only if you ask. Want me to tell her yes — and if so, what?

Yes, please ask her — something to eat or drink would be welcome, whatever she likes making. Just one thing: if she's planning to drop it off or stay, she should know Jordan will be here the whole time, since I can't keep that from happening.

allie-agent came back with two things, and the second one is for you to decide:

1. Allie says yes, please — **something to eat or drink would be welcome, whatever you like making**.
2. Important: **Jordan will be there the whole time (15:30–18:00)**, so if you planned to drop it off or stay a while, you'd run into him — Allie can't arrange otherwise. Your name still hasn't been mentioned to Jordan.

So you can either send it along without going yourself, or let me arrange it. Tell me what you'd like.

Yes, I'll make something to eat — cookies or a cake, tell me if there's anything to avoid. But I'd honestly rather not be there while Jordan is, so could you arrange for it to get to Allie's without me — I can drop it at her door before 15:30, or have it delivered.

Understood — you won't need to be there. I've asked allie-agent what Allie wants to avoid (allergies, anything she doesn't eat) and how she'd like it to arrive: door drop-off before 15:30 or a delivery. I'll come back with the answer and, if it's delivery, the details.
Perfect, thanks. I'll plan on cookies unless Allie says otherwise.

From Sarah's side: she'll make cookies or a cake. Two questions for you:
1. Anything to avoid — allergies or anything you don't eat?
2. How should it reach you without Sarah being there? Options: drop-off at your door before 15:30, or a courier (sarah-agent can arrange one — what time and where to leave it?). Your pick.
Good — cookies it is unless Allie says otherwise. I'll let you know.

No allergies I know of, and I'm not fussy — cookies or cake either way is lovely. Drop-off at my door before 15:30 is easiest; leave it in the entry by the door if I'm not back yet. No courier needed.

Allie's answers: **no allergies, not fussy — cookies or cake is lovely either way**. Easiest for her is a **drop-off at her door before 15:30**, left in the entry by the door if she isn't back yet. No courier needed — and you'd only be at the door, well before Jordan arrives at 15:30.

That works — I'll bake cookies and drop them at Allie's door Saturday morning, before 15:30, and leave them in the entry if she's out. Could you keep it to yourself that it's from me, in case Jordan's around early?

Will do — I won't put your name on anything and I won't say it's from you. I've only told allie-agent (so Allie knows to expect the drop-off Saturday morning, before 15:30, in the entry if she's out), and I asked it to keep you out of it if Jordan's around early. Allie knows it's you; Jordan won't hear it from me or from Allie's side.
That's exactly right — thank you. That's everything for now.
Any time, Sarah. Enjoy the baking — write me if anything changes.

Heads-up on the drop-off: Sarah will bake cookies and leave them at your door **Saturday morning** (before 15:30), in the entry if you're out — no name or note on them. She asks that if Jordan happens to be around early, he needn't be told they're from her. You know; I won't mention her to him.
Fine — Saturday morning works, and I won't bring Sarah up with Jordan. If he asks me straight out who made them, I'm not going to lie to him, but I won't volunteer it either.
